headline_seed: What Canadian Goods Will Take Trump’s 50% Tariffs? Some Pretty Strange Items. - The New York Times
draft_text: The U.S. imposed 50% tariffs on roughly $20 billion in Canadian goods Saturday after trade talks collapsed. PM Carney pledged dollar-for-dollar retaliation by September 8. Al Jazeera and CNBC both confirm hockey equipment, wine, and dairy are among the targets.
